# Superior Home Builders

Custom home builder and general contractor in Mount Vernon, Oregon specializing in custom home building, kitchen and bathroom remodeling, and commercial construction across Grant County and Eastern Oregon.

## About
Superior Home Builders is a licensed and insured general contractor based in Mount Vernon, Oregon, serving Grant County and Eastern Oregon for over 25 years. The company builds custom homes — including off-grid homes on rural land — and handles remodeling, framing, decks, window and door installation, and commercial construction. All projects start with a free on-site estimate and a written, itemized proposal.
